_about: Corrected times, keyed by log entry number or range. The logged time is kept and shown alongside. 'at' is HH:MM on the Saturday (7 Sept) unless 'sunday' is true.

70-81.note: Logged at 14:55 (which would be the Sunday afternoon). Placed at 17:15 on the Saturday, when other accounts say the afternoon raid hit Woolwich Arsenal.
